title: El 'Hub' de las Américas: Logística, banca y contrastes urbanos
goal: Analyze Panama's tertiary economic model (dollarization, Colón Free Zone, logistics, financial hub) and critique its sharp internal inequalities.
grammar: Modelo económico de hub logístico y financiero en Panamá

sections.title: Unit 8: Panama — Lesson 4
body: Welcome to lesson 4 of Unit 8 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Panama: The Interoceanic Crossroads, Global Commerce & Afro-Antillean Identity.
In this lesson, we study el 'hub' de las américas: logística, banca y contrastes urbanos, evaluating Panama's physical geography, sovereignty struggles, cultural pluralism, and economic paradoxes.

items: Analyze Panama's tertiary economic model (dollarization, Colón Free Zone, logistics, financial hub) and critique its sharp internal inequalities.
Master the lexicon and discourse of economia-hub-financiero-panama.
Incorporate regional terminology (el rascacielos, la opulencia).
